title: Waiting-on
description: Something another party owes the owner. The mirror of a commitment, not a status on one: here the owner is the creditor rather than the debtor, so the staleness question, the follow-up behaviour and the person's role all differ. This is the inbound half of the owner's second priority — nothing went quiet.

owed_by.description: Person ID if the identity is confirmed, otherwise the name as written. Per ADR-008 a name in a note creates no person record.

requested.description: When the owner asked. This is the clock 'gone quiet' is measured against.

status.description: open=asked, waiting | chased=followed up at least once | received=delivered | abandoned=stopped waiting without delivery

last_chased.description: Date of the most recent follow-up, so a chase that also went quiet is visible

received.description: When it actually arrived. Protected: an agent never invents completion of anything.
